name: AnimationBehavior
description: Represents the behavior of an animation effect, the main animation sequence, or an interactive animation sequence. The AnimationBehavior object is a member of the AnimationBehaviors collection.
example:
Sub Change()
    With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).TimeLine.MainSequence(1) _
            .Behaviors(1).RotationEffect
        .From = 1
        .To = 180
    End With
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Additive
properties.description: Sets or returns whether the current animation behavior is combined with other running animations. Read/write.

properties.name: Accumulate
properties.description: Determines whether animation behaviors accumulate. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of animation. Read/write.

properties.name: MotionEffect
properties.description: Returns a MotionEffect object that represents the properties of a motion animation.

properties.name: ColorEffect
properties.description: Returns a ColorEffect object that represents the color properties for a specified animation behavior.

properties.name: ScaleEffect
properties.description: Returns a ScaleEffect object for a given animation behavior. Read-only.

properties.name: RotationEffect
properties.description: Returns a RotationEffect object for an animation behavior. Read-only.

properties.name: PropertyEffect
properties.description: Returns a PropertyEffect object for a given animation behavior. Read-only.

properties.name: Timing
properties.description: Returns a Timing object that represents the timing properties for an animation sequence.

properties.name: CommandEffect
properties.description: Returns a CommandEffect object for the specified animation behavior. Read-only.

properties.name: FilterEffect
properties.description: Returns a FilterEffect object that represents a filter effect for an animation behavior. Read-only.

properties.name: SetEffect
properties.description: Returns a SetEffect object for the animation behavior. Read-only.
